video_title: Oso Ighodaro Training Camp Media Availability | Phoenix Suns | 9-30-26

quotes.speaker: Oso Ighodaro
quotes.summary_phrase: Oso Ighodaro emphasizes the importance of focusing on personal strengths over social media criticism.
quotes.excerpt: doubling down on who you are is extremely important
quotes.quote: I feel like it is super important. I feel like a lot of people on social media they focus on all of people's weaknesses and that can be almost paralyzing. But I feel like doubling down on who you are is extremely important. I got to this point because of what I bring to the game culturally, offensively and defensively. So it is super important that you don't lose sight in that and trying to master all these other pieces of the game when you can do things at an extremely high level that can impact winning.
quotes.social_post: Oso Ighodaro says focusing on personal strengths is key to success, noting that social media criticism can be paralyzing. He believes in doubling down on his own game to impact winning.

quotes.speaker: Oso Ighodaro
quotes.summary_phrase: Oso Ighodaro praises the defensive versatility of his teammates Ryan, Josh Okogie, and Dillon.
quotes.excerpt: having more versatile players like that is always an advantage
quotes.quote: It gives me someone that I know I can switch with and we don't lose anything on either matchup. So that is definitely an advantage. We have Ryan, Okogie, other big wings, Dillon that can also guard fives. So just having more versatile players like that is always an advantage.
quotes.social_post: Oso Ighodaro highlights the defensive versatility of the Phoenix Suns roster, noting that having players like Ryan, Josh Okogie, and Dillon who can switch onto different matchups is a major advantage.

quotes.speaker: Oso Ighodaro
quotes.summary_phrase: Oso Ighodaro praises a rookie teammate for his confidence and defensive contributions.
quotes.excerpt: He doesn't carry himself like a rookie
quotes.quote: He has been great. He just has a high level of confidence about himself. He doesn't carry himself like a rookie and he wants to learn, he wants to get better and I think he is really good at knowing his strengths and applying those. He is an extremely good rebounder. He guards the ball defensively. He is really good at pressing his advantages and if he continues to do so he will impact winning.
quotes.social_post: Oso Ighodaro is impressed with a rookie teammate, saying he does not carry himself like a rookie. He highlights his teammate's confidence, rebounding, and defensive ability as key assets for the team.

quotes.speaker: Oso Ighodaro
quotes.summary_phrase: Oso Ighodaro describes the increased competitiveness of Phoenix Suns training camp scrimmages.
quotes.excerpt: now we are just desperate to win
quotes.quote: It is almost more competitive because we are not so focused on bringing what we are learning because we already know what we are doing. So now we are just desperate to win. That last scrimmage was extremely competitive. Some questionable calls late, but it was extremely competitive and that is going to just get us better.
quotes.social_post: Oso Ighodaro says the Phoenix Suns training camp feels more competitive this year because the team is focused on winning rather than just learning new systems.
